termsPrivacyAccordion.header: What happens after I book a pooja?
termsPrivacyAccordion.content: Once you order a pooja from us, based on the date of pooja, we will assign a qualified Pandit Ji from our pool of registered Pandits – based on Language selection and type of Pooja requested – to conduct at your premises Please note – BookMyPooja strives best for allocating Pujaris based on your preferences. In case the specific language priest is not available for reasonable reasons, BookMyPooja team will allocate Pujaris in a related language. For example, if a Kannada Speaking preference priest is not available, alternative Tamil or Telugu speaking priest can be all0cated If a Marathi, Odiya or Bengali or Gujarati Speaking priest is not available, Hindi speaking priest may be allocated

Reschedule Policy – BookMyPoojaOnline.com

At BookMyPooja Online, we understand that plans may change. Our reschedule policy is designed to be flexible while ensuring smooth coordination with pandits and service arrangements.

1. Eligibility for Rescheduling
- Bookings can be rescheduled up to 48 hours before the scheduled pooja time
- Rescheduling requests made within 48 hours of the pooja are subject to pandit availability and approval

2. Number of Reschedules
- Any additional reschedule requests may attract a rescheduling fee (between 10% to 30% of booking fee) depending on the pooja type and arrangements already made

3. Process to Reschedule
- Customers must request rescheduling by contacting BookMyPooja Online customer support via call or WhatsApp, along with submitting a reschedule request directly through their booking portal in case you have booked from website
- New date and time will be confirmed based on pandit availability and muhurat

4. Samagri & Setup Impact
- If samagri or logistics have already been arranged, rescheduling may involve additional charges
- Fresh samagri requirements due to date change will be charged separately, if applicable

5. Force Majeure / Unavoidable Situations
- In cases of emergencies, health issues, or unavoidable circumstances, BookMyPooja Online will make best efforts to accommodate rescheduling without penalty

6. No-Show Policy
- If the customer is unavailable at the scheduled time without prior notice, the booking will be treated as completed, and rescheduling will not be permitted

7. Company Rights
- BookMyPooja Online reserves the right to reschedule or assign an alternate pandit in rare situations due to availability, emergencies, or unforeseen circumstances, while maintaining ritual integrity

8. Acceptance of Policy
- By booking a pooja on BookMyPoojaOnline.com, the customer agrees to this reschedule policy.
